row.proto: uint64_t Career_Collect_RndEntriesForDepartment(void *owner, void *out_arr, uint64_t dept_key, uint64_t kind)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Walks the department list (owner+0x2f8..+0x300, int key at +0) and collects the R&D development entries belonging to dept_key and kind into out_arr. Read-only.

verify.notes: V9695 Has a 5th mode argument and builds entries from the enabled-upgrade/calendar data (FUN_141244520, upgrade dev slots, day computation), not just a read of the dept list; dept list +0x2f8..0x300 stride 0x40 with int key matches.
